packageRules.description: Workflows hold the release signing keys: their updates are reviewed, never merged automatically.
The flake takes Rust from rust-overlay at rust-toolchain.toml's version. Wait until the daily flake.lock maintenance has locked an overlay that knows the release.
The Linux builds' ubuntu container sets the oldest glibc the packages run on (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13). Moving it is a release decision, made by hand.
